title: Rare early dependency beats frequent distractor
objective: Test whether a single early fact is recovered later despite many plausible repeated distractors.

setup.early_instruction: A deployment key named lighthouse is assigned to node ORCHID-17. This assignment appears only once and is authoritative.
setup.distractor_policy: Fill the middle context with repeated but non-authoritative references to lighthouse-like names and other nodes, especially ORCHID-71, ORCHID-07, and ORCHID-11. Distractors may appear more frequently but must be labeled as examples, rejected proposals, or unrelated tests.
setup.late_challenge: The final user asks: which node owns deployment key lighthouse? The correct answer is ORCHID-17, with enough explanation to show it ignored later distractors.

scoring_notes: Pass requires selecting ORCHID-17, not just mentioning it among alternatives.
If the model says the evidence is ambiguous because distractors are frequent, score as partial at best.
This task targets majority/distractor bias, not factual world knowledge.
